accept_criteria: calibration observation gate passed before comparative E10 work
repeatable source-view or fully verified coverage gain; dev oracle >=2 net tests across >=1 task and nonnegative pass@2 is positive screen signal only
one final confirmation only after independent authorization/configuration freeze; CI crossing zero remains inconclusive

calibration_gate_before_E10.failure_action: stop without comparative candidate dispatch, no retry; remaining ceiling is not authority
required: complete exclusive host phase observations with explicit overlap and unknowns
reservations/completions/tokens reconcile; partial verifier never enters pool
default vote/ranking/reset/source evidence parity; record observation overhead

changed_factor: interleaved versus first-occurrence FIFO deferred verification schedule

confirmation.status: not authorized, not independently assigned to E10

controls.fallback: existing separately audited filler; never model-pool credit
controls.parent_hard_watchdog: identical task/session watchdog in both arms; no candidate-only test kill
controls.sampler_and_augmentation: unchanged source full 128-row epoch; generation augment(n=2,seed=2); verification hash(base_key) with startup seed 0
controls.vote_multiplicity: retain every original occurrence/provenance; score reuse only

deployment_claims: research licensing/model/rules statements not independently revalidated for deployment
future_item_implementation: not implemented or dispatched by E00
kill_criteria: lost votes, changed default method, budget overrun or repeatable verified oracle/pass@2 regression
only raw-returned gain without fully verified mechanism/quality support: stop expansion as no-support or inconclusive

partition.allowed_inputs: train input/output and test input only; no test output, label, score, oracle or difficulty route
partition.confirmation_unlock: one frozen final configuration and one separately authorized comparison across all Stage4 searches
partition.qualification: previously examined public data and unresolved checkpoint exposure; Stage4 decision isolation, never fresh holdout
partition.selection: sort by SHA256(seed || canonical visible task digest || task ID), first 24 dev; all others confirmation
partition.unit: whole task including every actual test

screen.hardware: four distinct BF16 NVIDIA L4s, four independent workers
screen.purpose_of_bounds: planning caps, not throughput estimates or execution permission; bind exact test/material counts in a new plan before approval

selected_local_scope: E00 remaining telemetry/fakes; no new model experiment

statistic.paired_task_cluster_bootstrap: recompute sum(correct)/sum(tests) after each whole-task paired draw
statistic.primary: test-micro pass@2 and verified pool oracle; complete actual denominator
statistic.task_macro: separate diagnostic, never substituted for test-micro
statistic.technical_repeats: average paired repeated observations within task; do not count as independent clusters

stop_criteria: stop at workload or session cap, including startup/load/training/guards/export/cleanup
no automatic retry, new identity, quota expansion, confirmation unlock or official submission
unknown license/source/deployment/rules/hardware/resource sufficiency must resolve before any owner execution
